critical_code_review_comments: youtube_sync.py:308 sync_all_channels iterates every handle in _all_handles() (primary + YOUTUBE_EXTRA_HANDLES) and returns aggregated {ok, handles, channels, upserted, skipped}. Non-throwing per-channel — a single channel failure only sets that entry's ok=false, doesn't abort the batch.

Admin phone +250794230137 always returns testCode inline. Notable API shapes surfaced: (1) POST /billing/stripe/create-checkout expects `purchase_type` (subscription|vod) + optional plan or show_id; response key is `checkoutUrl` (not `url`). (2) POST /billing/subscribe expects `method` (stripe|paypal|mtn_momo|airtel). (3) POST /admin/youtube/sync with no body syncs ALL configured channels via sync_all_channels; body {handle:'@X'} syncs just X. Response is { ok, handles, channels:[…], upserted, skipped }. (4) GET /admin/youtube/status may include a legacy 'youtube_sync' key with no categorySlug — filter to key.startswith('youtube_sync:') for per-channel listing.
